narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ سَمْعَانَ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كَانَ مُجَاهِدُ بْنُ جَبْرٍ يَقُولُ فِي الْمُحَارِبِ الْمُرْتَدِّ عَنِ الإِسْلامِ الْمُشْرِكِ أَنْ يُصْلَبَ فَيُقْتَلَ مَصْلُوبًا
records.isnad_en: And Ibn Sam'an informed me; he said:
records.matn_en: Mujahid b. Jabr used to say, regarding the muharib who has apostatized from Islam, the polytheist: he is crucified and killed while crucified.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ سَمْعَانَ أَنَّ غَالِبَ بْنَ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ أَخْبَرَهُ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ مِنَ الْعُلَمَاءِ أَنَّهُ مَضَتِ السُّنَّةُ فِي الْمُحَارِبِ الْخَارِبِ إِذَا قَتَلَ وَأَصَابَ الأَمْوَالَ أَنْ يُصْلَبَ فَيُقْتَلَ مَصْلُوبًا
records.isnad_en: And Ibn Sam'an informed me that Ghalib b. 'Ubayd Allah informed him
records.matn_en: that he heard those he met among the scholars [say] that the sunna has gone, regarding the muharib and bandit, that if he kills and takes property, he is crucified and killed while crucified.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: Unnamed scholars (via Ghalib b. 'Ubayd Allah) (later authority)

records.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَسَمِعْتُ اللَّيْثَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ يَقُولُ
records.matn_ar: فِي الَّذِي يَقْتُلُ وَيَأْخُذُ الْمَالَ أَنَّهُ يُصْلَبُ حَيًّا وَيُطْعَنُ بِالْحَرْبَةِ حَتَّى يَمُوتَ، وَالَّذِي يُقْتَلُ بِغَيْرِ صَلْبٍ أَنَّهُ يُقْتَلُ بِالسَّيْفِ.
records.isnad_en: He said: And I heard al-Layth b. Sa'd say
records.matn_en: regarding the one who kills and takes property, that he is crucified alive and speared with the lance until he dies; and the one who is killed without crucifixion is killed by the sword.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

groups.title_en: What has come regarding the killing of the Haruriyya (Kharijites)

records.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لِعَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ: مَا يُحِلُّ لِي قِتَالَ الْحَرُورِيَّةِ قَالَ: إِذَا قَطَعُوا السَّبِيلَ وَأَخَافُوا الآمِنَ، قَالَ: فَقُلْتُ لِعَطَاءٍ: فَقَاتَلَتِ الْحَرُورِيَّةُ، ثُمَّ أُخِذُوا، قَالَ: يُقْتَلُ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ قَتَلَ، وَيُؤْخَذُ الْمَتَاعُ مِمَّنْ أَخَذَهُ مِنْهُمْ، وَلا يُقَطَّعُ، وَيُسْجَنُ مِنْ نَفْيٍ، وَيُسْتَتَابُونَ وَلا يُقْتَلُونَ. قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ: وَقَالَهُ عَبْدُ الْكَرِيمِ
records.isnad_en: He said: And Muhammad b. 'Amr informed me, from Ibn Jurayj, who said:
records.matn_en: I said to 'Ata' b. Abi Rabah: “What makes it lawful for me to fight the Haruriyya?” He said: “When they cut the road and terrify the secure.” I said to 'Ata': “The Haruriyya fought, and then were seized?” He said: “Whoever of them killed is killed, and the goods are taken from whoever took them, and he is not cut; and whoever [is liable to] banishment is imprisoned; and they are asked to repent and are not killed.” Ibn Jurayj said: 'Abd al-Karim said it too.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: قَالَ ابْنُ وَهْبٍ: وَبَلَغَنِي عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَتَبَ فِي خَارِجِيٍّ خَرَجَ بِخُرَسَانَ فَأَشَارَ بِسَيْفِهِ فَأُخِذَ، إِنْ كَانَ قَتَلَ قُتِلَ، وَإِنْ كَانَ جَرَحَ جُرِحَ، وَإِلا اسْتُودِعَ السِّجْنَ، فَاجْعَلُوا أَهْلَهُ قَرِيبًا مِنْهُ حَتَّى يَتُوبَ مِنْ رَأْيِهِ السُّوءِ. وَقَالَ الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ مُزَاحِمٍ مِثْلَهُ.
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: And it has reached me concerning 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz
records.matn_en: that he wrote regarding a Kharijite who rose in Khurasan and brandished his sword and was seized: “If he killed, he is killed; if he wounded, he is wounded; otherwise he is committed to prison. Place his family close to him until he repents of his evil opinion.” And al-Dahhak b. Muzahim said the like of it.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي مَسْلَمَةُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، وَغَيْرُهُ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْحَرُورِيَّةِ:
records.matn_ar: إِذَا خَرَجُوا فَسَفَكُوا الدِّمَاءَ فَقِتَالُهُمْ حَلالٌ. قَالَ: وَسَمِعْتُ مَنْ أَرْضَى مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Maslama b. 'Ali and others informed me, from al-Awza'i, that he said regarding the Haruriyya:
records.matn_en: If they rise and shed blood, fighting them is lawful. He said: And I heard those among the people of knowledge with whom I am satisfied say that.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: ذَكَرْتُ الْخَوَارِجَ وَاجْتِهَادَهُمْ عِنْدَ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ وَأَنَا عِنْدَهُ، قَالَ: فَسَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ: لَيْسُوا بِأَشَدِّ اجْتِهَادًا مِنَ الْيَهُودِ وَالنَّصَارَى، ثُمَّ هُمْ يُضَلُّونَ
records.isnad_en: And Sufyan b. 'Uyayna narrated to me, from 'Ubayd Allah b. Abi Yazid, who said:
records.matn_en: I mentioned the Khawarij and their diligence in worship in the presence of Ibn 'Abbas while I was with him. He said: I heard him say: “They are no more diligent than the Jews and Christians, yet they are led astray.”

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ الْحَرُورِيَّةَ خَرَجَتْ فَنَازَعُوا عَلِيًّا وَفَارَقُوهُ وَشَهِدُوا عَلَيْهِ بِالشِّرْكِ، فَلَمْ يَهْجُهُمْ، ثُمَّ خَرَجُوا إِلَى حَرُورَاءَ، فَأُتِيَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ فَأُخْبِرَ أَنَّهُمْ يَتَجَهَّزُونَ مِنَ الْكُوفَةِ، فَقَالَ: دَعُوهُمْ، ثُمَّ خَرَجُوا فَنَزَلُوا بِالنَّهْرَوَانِ فَمَكَثُوا بِهِ شَهْرًا، فَقِيلَ لَهُ: أَغْزِهِمُ الآنَ، فَقَالَ: لا، حَتَّى يُهَرِيقُوا الدِّمَاءَ وَيَقْطَعُوا السَّبِيلَ وَيُخِيفُوا الأَمْنَ، فَلَمْ يَهْجُهُمْ حَتَّى قَتَلُوا، فَأَغْزَاهُمْ، فَقُتِلُوا
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Muhammad b. 'Amr informed me, from Ibn Jurayj, from 'Abd al-Karim,
records.matn_en: that the Haruriyya rose, disputed with 'Ali, left him and testified against him of polytheism, and he did not attack them. Then they went out to Harura'. 'Ali b. Abi Talib was told that they were equipping themselves at al-Kufa; he said: “Leave them.” Then they went out and camped at al-Nahrawan and stayed there a month. It was said to him: “Fight them now.” He said: “No, not until they spill blood, cut the road, and terrify the secure.” So he did not attack them until they killed; then he sent forces against them, and they were killed.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: بَيْنَا نَحْنُ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﵇، وَهُوَ يَقْسِمُ قَسْمًا، أَتَاهُ ذُو الْخُوَيْصِرَةِ، وَهُوَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي تَمِيمٍ، فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَعْدِلْ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﵇: وَيْلَكَ، وَمَنْ يَعْدِلُ إِذَا لَمْ أَعْدِلْ، قَدْ خِبْتَ وَخَسِرْتَ إِنْ لَمْ أَعْدِلْ، قَالَ عُمَرُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، ائْذَنْ لِي فِيهِ أَضْرِبَ عُنُقَهُ، قَالَ: دَعْهُ، فَإِنَّ لَهُ أَصْحَابًا يُحَقِّرُ أَحَدُكُمْ صَلاتَهُ مَعَ صَلاتِهِمْ وَصِيَامَهُ مَعَ صِيَامِهِمْ، يَقْرَءُونَ الْقُرْآنَ لا يُجَاوِزُ تَرَاقِيَهُمْ، يَمْرُقُونَ مِنَ الإِسْلامِ كَمَا يَمْرُقُ السَّهْمُ مِنَ الرَّمِيَّةِ، يُنْظَرُ إِلَى نَصْلِهِ فَلا يُوجَدُ فِيهِ شَيْءٌ، ثُمَّ يُنْظَرُ إِلَى رِصَافِهِ فَلا يُوجَدُ فِيهِ شَيْءٌ، ثُمَّ يُنْظَرُ إِلَى نَضِيِّهِ فَلا يُوجَدُ فِيهِ شَيْءٌ، وَهُوَ الْقِدْحُ، ثُمَّ يُنْظَرُ إِلَى قُذَذِهِ فَلا يُوجَدُ فِيهِ شَيْءٌ، سَبَقَ الْفَرْثَ وَالدَّمَ، آيَتُهُمْ رَجُلٌ أَسْوَدُ، إِحْدَى عَضُدَيْهِ مِثْلَ ثَدْيِ الْمَرْأَةِ، أَوْ مِثْلَ الْبَضْعَةِ تَدَرْدَرُ، يَخْرُجُونَ عَلَى خَيْرِ فِرْقَةٍ مِنَ النَّاسِ. قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيُّ: فَأَشْهَدُ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ هَذَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ قَاتَلَهُمْ وَأَنَا مَعَهُ، فَأَمَرَ بِذَلِكَ الرَّجُلِ، فَالْتُمِسَ فَوُجِدَ فَأُتِيَ بِهِ حَتَّى نَظَرْتُ إِلَيْهِ عَلَى نَعْتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﵇ الَّذِي نَعَتَ
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab, who said: Abu Salama b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Awf informed me, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, who said:
records.matn_en: While we were with the Messenger of God ﷺ, who was dividing a share, Dhu al-Khuwaysira, a man of the Banu Tamim, came to him and said: “O Messenger of God, be just!” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Woe to you! Who will be just if I am not just? You would be ruined and lost if I were not just.” 'Umar said: “O Messenger of God, permit me to strike his neck.” He said: “Leave him, for he has companions such that one of you would belittle his prayer beside their prayer and his fasting beside their fasting. They recite the Qur'an but it does not pass their collarbones. They pass through Islam as the arrow passes through the game. One looks at its blade and finds nothing on it; then at its binding (risaf) and finds nothing; then at its shaft (nadiyy), which is the wooden stick (qidh), and finds nothing; then at its feathers (qudhadh) and finds nothing: it has outstripped the dung and blood. Their sign is a black man, one of whose arms is like a woman's breast, or like a quivering piece of flesh. They go out at a time of division among the best group of people.” Abu Sa'id al-Khudri said: I bear witness that I heard this from the Messenger of God, and I bear witness that 'Ali b. Abi Talib fought them, and I was with him. He ordered that man be sought; he was found and brought, until I looked at him, matching the description of the Messenger of God ﷺ that he had described.

narrators.ar: أبو سلمة بن عبد الرحمن بن عوف

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: The Prophet ﷺ (via Abu Sa'id al-Khudri) (prophetic)

records.isnad_ar: وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ الأَشَجِّ، عَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﵇ يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: إِنَّ الْحَرُورِيَّةَ لَمَّا خَرَجَتْ وَهُوَ مَعَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ فَقَالُوا: لا حُكْمَ إِلا لِلَّهِ، قَالَ عَلِيٌّ: كَلِمَةُ حَقٍّ أُرِيدَ بِهَا بَاطِلٌ، إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَصَفَ نَاسًا، إِنِّي لَأَعْرِفُ صِفَتَهُمْ فِي هَؤُلاءِ، يَقُولُونَ الْحَقَّ بِأَلْسِنَتِهِمْ لا يُجَاوِزُ هَذَا مِنْهُمْ، وَأَشَارَ إِلَى حَلْقِهِ، مِنْ أَبْغَضِ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ إِلَيْهِ مِنْهُمْ أَسْوَدُ إِحْدَى يَدَيْهِ طُبْيُ شَاةٍ أَوْ حَلَمَةُ ثَدْيٍ، فَلَمَّا قَتَلَهُمْ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ قَالَ: انْظُرُوا، فَنَظَرُوا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا شَيْئًا، قَالَ: ارْجِعُوا فَوَاللَّهِ ، مَا كَذَبْتُ وَلا كُذِبْتُ، مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاثًا، ثُمَّ وَجَدُوهُ فِي خَرِبَةٍ فَأَتَوْا بِهِ حَتَّى وَضَعُوهُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ. فَقَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ: أَنَا حَاضِرٌ ذَلِكَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ وَقَوْلِ عَلِيٍّ فِيهِمْ. قَالَ بُكَيْرٌ: وَحَدَّثَنِي رَجُلٌ عَنِ ابْنِ حُنَيْنٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ ذَلِكَ الأَسْوَدَ
records.isnad_en: And 'Amr b. al-Harith informed me, from Bukayr b. al-Ashajj, from Busr b. Sa'id, from 'Ubayd Allah b. Abi Rafi', mawla of the Messenger of God ﷺ, who said:
records.matn_en: When the Haruriyya rose, while he was with 'Ali b. Abi Talib, and they said: “Judgment belongs only to God,” 'Ali said: “A word of truth by which falsehood is intended. The Messenger of God ﷺ described some people, and I know their description in these: they speak the truth with their tongues, and it does not pass this” (and he pointed to his throat). “The most hateful of God's creation to Him among them is a black man, one of whose hands is like a ewe's teat or the nipple of a breast.” When 'Ali b. Abi Talib had killed them, he said: “Look.” They looked and found nothing. He said: “Go back; by God, I have not lied and I have not been lied to,” twice or three times. Then they found him in a ruin and brought him until they placed him before him. 'Ubayd Allah said: I was present at that, at their affair and at 'Ali's statement about them. Bukayr said: And a man narrated to me from Ibn Hunayn that he said: I saw that black man.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: 'Ali b. Abi Talib (Companion) reporting the Prophet's description (mixed)

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الأَشَجِّ، أَنَّ رَجُلا حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: أَرْسَلَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ إِلَى الْحَرُورِيَّةِ لأُكَلِّمَهُمْ، فَلَمَّا قَالُوا: لا حُكْمَ إِلا لِلَّهِ، قُلْتُ: أَجَلْ صَدَّقْتُمْ، لا حُكْمَ إِلا لِلَّهِ ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ حَكَمَ فِي رَجُلٍ وَامْرَأَةٍ، وَحَكَمَ فِي قَتْلِ الصَّيْدِ، فَالْحُكْمُ فِي رَجُلٍ وَامْرَأَةٍ وَصَيْدٍ أَفْضَلُ أَمِ الْحُكْمِ فِي الْأُمَّةِ تَرْجِعُ بِهِ وَتُحْقَنُ دِمَاؤُهَا وََيُلَمُّ شَعَثُهَا، قَالَ ابْنُ الْكَوَاءِ، دَعُوهُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَنْبَأَكُمْ أَنَّهُمْ {قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ} [الزخرف: 58]
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: 'Amr b. al-Harith informed me, from Bukayr b. 'Abd Allah b. al-Ashajj, that a man narrated to him from 'Abd Allah b. 'Abbas that he said:
records.matn_en: 'Ali b. Abi Talib sent me to the Haruriyya to speak with them. When they said: “Judgment belongs only to God,” I said: “Yes, you have spoken truly: judgment belongs only to God. God has made a judgment concerning a man and a woman [in dispute], and made a judgment concerning the killing of game. Is judgment concerning a man and a woman and game better, or judgment concerning the community, by which it is brought back, its blood is spared, and its dispersion gathered?” Ibn al-Kawwa' said: “Leave him, for God has informed you that they are {a contentious people} [al-Zukhruf 43:58].”

narrators.en: A man (not named in the text)
'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: وَأَخْبَرَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْعُمَرِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ
records.matn_ar: وَذَكَرَ الْحَرُورِيَّةَ، فَقَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﵇: «يَمْرُقُونَ مِنَ الإِسْلامِ مُرُوقَ السَّهْمِ مِنَ الرَّمِيَّةِ»
records.isnad_en: And 'Umar b. Muhammad al-'Umari b. Zayd b. 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar b. al-Khattab informed me, from his father, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar,
records.matn_en: and he mentioned the Haruriyya, and said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “They pass through Islam as the arrow passes through the game.”

narrators.en: Father of 'Umar b. Muhammad al-'Umari (not named in the text)

narrators.ar: عمر بن محمد بن زيد العمري

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّ بُكَيْرًا حَدَّثَهُ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ نَافِعًا: كَيْفَ كَانَ رَأْيُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ فِي الْحَرُورِيَّةِ، قَالَ: يَرَاهُمْ شِرَارَ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: إِنَّهُمُ انْطَلَقُوا إِلَى آيَاتٍ أُنْزِلَتْ فِي الْكُفَّارِ فَجَعَلُوهَا عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
records.isnad_en: And 'Amr b. al-Harith informed me that Bukayr narrated to him
records.matn_en: that he asked Nafi': “What was 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar's opinion about the Haruriyya?” He said: “He regarded them as the worst of God's creation. He said: They set out to verses that were revealed about the unbelievers and applied them to the believers.”

narrators.ar: نافع مولى عبد الله بن عمر

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ سَمْعَانَ ، أَنَّ نَافِعًا أَخْبَرَهُ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ كَانَ إِذَا سُئِلَ عَنِ الْحَرُورِيَّةِ فَقَالَ: يَكَفِّرُونَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَيَسْتَحِلُّونَ دِمَاءَهُمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُمْ، وَيَنْكِحُونَ النِّسَاءَ فِي عَدَدِهِمْ، وَتَأْتِيهِمُ الْمَرْأَةُ فَيَنْكِحُهَا الرَّجُلُ مِنْهُمْ وَلَهَا زَوْجٌ، فَتَكُونُ الْمَرْأَةُ عِنْدَهُمْ لَهَا زَوْجَانِ، فَلا أَعْلَمُ أَحَدًا أَحَقَّ بِالْقِتَالِ وَالْقَتْلَ مِنَ الْحَرُورِيَّةِ
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Ibn Sam'an informed me that Nafi' informed him
records.matn_en: that 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, when asked about the Haruriyya, would say: “They declare the Muslims unbelievers, regard their blood and property as lawful, and marry women within their number; a woman comes to them and a man of them marries her while she has a husband, so that a woman among them has two husbands. I know of no one more deserving of fighting and killing than the Haruriyya.”

narrators.ar: نافع مولى عبد الله بن عمر

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ مَوْلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قَدِمَ جَيْشٌ مِنَ الْحَرُورِيَّةِ فِي الْفِتْنَةِ وَهُمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْيَمَامَةِ، فَأَغَارُوا لِيَأْخُذُوا أَمْوَالَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَيَقْتُلُوا مَنْ دَفَعَ عَنْ مَالِهِ وَنَفْسِهِ، حَتَّى دَنَوْا مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ فَكَانُوا مِنْهَا مَسِيرَةَ لَيْلَةٍ وَيَوْمٍ، فَدَعَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَيَّاشِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ فَقَالَ: اخْرُجْ إِلَى النَّاسِ وَكَلِّمْهُمْ، فَإِنْ كَانَ عِنْدَهُمْ قِتَالٌ لِهَؤُلاءِ قُمْنَا فَقَاتَلْنَا مَعَهُمْ، وَإِنْ كَانَ لَيْسَ عِنْدَهُمْ قِتَالٌ خَرَجْنَا إِلَى مَكَّةَ وَلَمْ نَعْرِضْهُمْ دِينَنَا وَدِمَاءَنَا، وَكَانَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ بِحِدْثَانِ مَا أُصِيبَ أَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ بِالْحَرَّةِ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَيَّاشٍ: النَّاسُ حَدِيثُو عَهْدٍ بِنَكْبَةٍ شَدِيدَةٍ، وَإِنَّكَ إِنْ تُكَلِّمَهُمْ يَقُولُوا: نَعَمْ، ثُمَّ يَفِرُّوا عَنْكَ وَلا يُقَاتِلُوا مَعَكَ، فَلَمَّا رَأَيَا ذَلِكَ ارْتَحَلا مِنْ لَيْلَتِهِمَا وَأَنَا مَعَهُمَا وَنَاسٌ، فَلَحِقُوا بِمَكَّةَ، ثُمَّ رَدَّ اللَّهُ أُولَئِكَ الْحَرُورِيَّةَ عَنِ الْمَدِينَةِ فَلَمْ يَقْدَمُوهَا
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Yunus b. Yazid informed me, from Nafi', the mawla of 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, who said:
records.matn_en: An army of the Haruriyya, from the people of al-Yamama, came during the fitna; they raided to seize the property of the Muslims and to kill whoever defended his property and himself, until they drew near Medina, being a night and a day's journey from it. 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar called 'Abd Allah b. 'Ayyash b. Abi Rabi'a and said: “Go out to the people and speak to them. If they have the will to fight these men, we will stand and fight with them; and if they have no will to fight, we will go out to Mecca and not expose our religion and our blood to them.” That was soon after what befell the people of Medina at al-Harra. Ibn 'Ayyash said: “The people are recently afflicted with a severe calamity, and if you speak to them they will say yes, then flee from you and not fight with you.” When the two saw that, they departed that night, and I was with them and some people, and they joined Mecca. Then God turned those Haruriyya away from Medina and they did not come to it.

narrators.ar: نافع مولى عبد الله بن عمر

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ: وَحَدَّثَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ اللَّيْثِيُّ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ جَيْشَ الْحَرُورِيَّةِ نَزَلُوا بِنَخْلٍ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْمَدِينَةِ لَيْلَتَانِ، ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ نَحْوَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb: And Usama b. Zayd al-Laythi narrated to me, from Nafi',
records.matn_en: that the army of the Haruriyya camped at Nakhl, two nights from Medina; then he mentioned something like this report.

narrators.ar: نافع مولى عبد الله بن عمر

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: وَأَخْبَرَنِي اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: خَرَجَ أَرْبَعُونَ حَرُورِيًّا فِي زَمَانِ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِمْ يَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى الْجَمَاعَةِ وَيُنْكِرُ عَلَيْهِمْ خُرُوجَهُمْ خِلافًا لِلْحَقِّ وَالسُّنَّةِ، وَأَنْتُمْ قَلِيلٌ أَذِلَّةٌ، فَكَتَبُوا إِلَيْهِ جَوَابًا أَبْلَغُوا فِيهِ فَقَالُوا: أَمَّا مَا ذَكَرْتَ مِنْ قِلَّتِنَا وَذِلَّتِنَا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَالَ لأَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﵇: {وَاذْكُرُوا إِذْ أَنْتُمْ قَلِيلٌ مُسْتَضْعَفُونَ فِي الأَرْضِ تَخَافُونَ أَنْ يَتَخَطَّفَكُمُ النَّاسُ فَآوَاكُمْ وَأَيَّدَكُمْ بِنَصْرِهِ} [الأنفال: 26] ، فَنَحْنُ نَرْجُو ذَلِكَ. فَبَعَثَ إِلَيْهِمْ عَوْنَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ الْهُذَلِيُّ، فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ عَلَيْهِمْ قَالَ لَهُمْ: قَاتَلْتُمْ دَهْرَكُمْ كُلَّهُ عَلَى أَنْ يَعْمَلَ بِالَّذِي عَمِلَ بِهِ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، فَلَمَّا جَاءَ رَأْيُكُمُ الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ تَطْلُبُونَ، وَقَالَ النَّاسُ: هَذَا، وَاللَّهِ ، رَأْيُهُمْ، كُنْتُمْ أَوَّلُ مَنْ نَفَرَ عَنْهُ، قَالُوا: وَاللَّهِ ، لَقَدْ صَدَقْتَ مَا كُنَّا نَطْلُبُ إِلا الَّذِي عَمِلَ بِهِ، وَلَكِنَّهُ لَمْ يَتَبَرَّأْ مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَانُوا قَبْلَهُ، وَلَمْ يَلْعَنْهُمْ ، فَقُلْتُ: هَلْ أَنْتُمْ صَادِقِيَّ عَمَّا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَنْهُ، فَقَالُوا: نَعَمْ، لَمْ تَسْأَلْنَا عَنْ شَيْءٍ إِلا صَدَقْنَاكَ، فَقُلْتُ: مَتَى عَهْدُكُمْ بِلَعْنِ هَامَانَ؟ فَقَالُوا: مَا لَعَنَّاهُ قَطُّ فَقُلْتُ لَهُمْ: أَفَيَسَعُكُمْ أَنْ تَتْرُكُوا وَزِيرَ فِرْعَوْنَ الْمُنَفِّذَ لأَمْرِهِ، وَلا يَسَعُ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ أَنْ يَعْمَلَ بِالْحَقِّ وَيَكُفَّ اللَّعْنَ عَنْ أَهْلِ قِبْلَتِهِ إِنْ كَانُوا أَخْطَئُوا فِي شَيْءٍ وَعَمِلُوا بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ. فَرَجَعَ إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ فَأَخْبَرَهُ، فَقَالَ: مَا أُحِبُّ أَنِّي بَعَثْتُ إِلَيْهِمْ غَيْرَكَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: كَيْفَ فَطِنْتَ لِهَامَانَ، فَقَالَ: تَخَوَّفْتُ إِنْ ذَكَرْتُ فِرْعَوْنَ أَنْ يَقُولُوا قَدْ لَعَنَّاهُ فَإِنَّهُ مُلْعَنٌ خَبِيثٌ. قَالَ: وَكَتَبَ عُمَرُ إِلَى يَحْيَى بْنِ يَحْيَى الْغَسَّانِيِّ وَكَانَ عَلَى الْمَوْصِلِ أَنْ أَقْرِرْهُمْ مَا لَمْ يَسْفِكُوا دَمًا أَوْ يَقْطَعُوا سَبِيلا أَوْ يُخِيفُوا مُعَاهِدًا، فَإِنْ فَعَلُوا شَيْئًا مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَهُمُ الْعَدُوُّ، فَاقْتُلُوهُمْ حَيْثُ ثَقِفْتُمُوهُمْ، فَأَمْسَكُوا بِأَيْدِيهِمْ حَتَّى تُوُفِّيَ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ. ثُمَّ خَرَجُوا فِي خِلافَةِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، فَقُتِلُوا.
records.isnad_en: And al-Layth b. Sa'd informed me; he said:
records.matn_en: Forty Haruris rose in the time of 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz. He wrote to them calling them to the community and denouncing their rising contrary to the truth and the sunna, [saying]: “and you are few and abased.” They wrote back an answer in which they were forceful, saying: “As for what you mentioned of our fewness and abasement, God said to the Companions of the Messenger of God ﷺ: {And remember when you were few and oppressed in the land, fearing that people might abduct you, but He sheltered you and supported you with His help} [al-Anfal 8:26]; and we hope for that.” So he sent to them 'Awn b. 'Abd Allah b. 'Utba b. Mas'ud al-Hudhali. When he came to them he said to them: “You fought all your time for [the desire] that someone act as 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz has acted; and when your opinion that you were seeking came, and people said: this, by God, is their opinion, you were the first to flee from it.” They said: “By God, you have spoken truly: we sought nothing but what he did; but he did not disown those before him and did not curse them.” I said: “Will you answer me truthfully about what I ask?” They said: “Yes; you will not ask us anything but we will tell you the truth.” I said: “When did you last curse Haman?” They said: “We never cursed him.” I said to them: “Does it suffice you to leave the minister of Pharaoh who carried out his command, yet it does not suffice 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz to act with the truth and withhold cursing from the people of his qibla, if they erred in something and acted without the truth?” He returned to 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz and told him, and he said: “I would not have wished to send anyone to them but you.” He said to him: “How did you think of Haman?” He said: “I feared that if I mentioned Pharaoh they would say: we have cursed him, for he is accursed, vile.” He said: And 'Umar wrote to Yahya b. Yahya al-Ghassani, who was in charge of al-Mawsil: “Leave them as long as they do not shed blood, cut the road, or terrify a covenanter; if they do any of that they are the enemy, so kill them wherever you find them.” So they held back their hands until 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz died. Then they rose in the caliphate of Yazid b. 'Abd al-Malik and were killed.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: al-Layth b. Sa'd (historical account of 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz's conduct) (later authority)

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلا مِنَ الْحَرُورِيَّةِ قَالَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ: إِنَّكَ كَافِرٌ، قَالَ لَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ: كَذَبْتَ، ثُمَّ لَقِيَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ يَأَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ لا أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ، فَقَرَأَهَا حَتَّى خَتَمَهَا: قَالَ الْحَرُورِيُّ: قَالَ اللَّهُ: {بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ} [الزخرف: 58]
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Ibn Lahi'a informed me, from Yazid b. Abi Habib,
records.matn_en: that a man of the Haruriyya said to 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar: “You are an unbeliever.” 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar said to him: “You lie.” Then he met 'Abd Allah b. 'Abbas and said the same to him. Ibn 'Abbas said: “In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: O disbelievers, I do not worship what you worship”, and he recited it until he finished it. The Haruri said: “God said: {Rather, they are a contentious people} [al-Zukhruf 43:58].”

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: Yazid b. Abi Habib (account of an exchange with two Companions) (successor)

groups.title_en: Chapter on the killing of the Qadariyya

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ أَبِي سُهَيْلِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: سَأَلَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ وَأَنَا مَعَهُ: مَاذَا تَرَى فِي هَؤُلاءِ الْقَدَرِيَّةِ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: أَسْتَتِيبُهُمْ، فَإِنْ قَبِلُوا ذَلِكَ وَإِلا فَأَعْرِضُهُمْ عَلَى السَّيْفِ، قَالَ عُمَرُ: وَأَنَا أَرَى ذَلِكَ. قَالَ مَالِكٌ: وَرَأْيِيِ عَلَى ذَلِكَ
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Malik informed me, from his uncle Abu Suhayl b. Malik, who said:
records.matn_en: 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz asked me, while I was with him: “What do you think of these Qadariyya?” I said: “I would ask them to repent; if they accept that, [well]; otherwise I would present them to the sword.” 'Umar said: “And I hold that.” Malik said: And my opinion is on that.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: Abu Suhayl b. Malik (exchange with 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz) (successor)

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سُهَيْلٍ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ قَالَ لَهُ: مَا الْحُكْمُ فِي هَؤُلاءِ الْقَدَرِيَّةِ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: يُسْتَتَابُونَ، فَإِنْ تَابُوا قُبِلَ ذَلِكَ مِنْهُمْ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا قُوتِلُوا عَلَى وَجْهِ الْبَغْيِ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: ذَلِكَ الرَّأْيُ فِيهِمْ، وَيْحَهُمْ، فَأَيْنَ هُمْ عَنْ هَذِهِ الآيَةِ: {فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ {161} مَا أَنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَاتِنِينَ {162} إِلا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ الْجَحِيمِ {163} } [الصافات: 161-163]
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Usama b. Zayd narrated to me, from Abu Suhayl,
records.matn_en: that 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz said to him: “What is the ruling regarding these Qadariyya?” I said: “They are asked to repent; if they repent it is accepted from them; if they do not repent they are fought as rebels.” 'Umar said: “That is the opinion about them. Woe to them! Where are they from this verse: {For indeed, you and what you worship (161) Cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him (162) Except he who will [enter and] burn in the Hellfire (163)} [al-Saffat 37:161-163]?”

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: Abu Suhayl b. Malik (exchange with 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz) (successor)

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلا مِنَ الْقَدَرِيَّةِ قَالَ: إِنَّ مَعَنَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ يَزِيدَ بْنِ هُرْمُزَ، وَعُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، فَسُئِلَ ابْنُ هُرْمُزَ، فَقَالَ: كَذَبَ، وَاللَّهِ، لَقَدْ أَدْرَكْتُ الْمَدِينَةَ وَمَا يُذْكَرُ فِيهَا إِلا رَجُلٌ وَاحِدٌ مِنْ جُهَيْنَةَ يُقَالُ لَهُ مَعْبَدٌ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُ أَبَا سُهَيْلٍ عَمَّ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ فَقَالَ: كَذَبَ، اسْتَشَارَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ فَقَالَ لِي: كَيْفَ تَرَى فِي الَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِالْقَدَرِ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: أَرَى أَنْ يُسْتَتَابُوا، فَإِنْ تَابُوا وَإِلا ضَرَبْتُ رِقَابَهُمْ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: ذَلِكَ الرَّأْيُ فِيهِمْ، وَاللَّهِ، لَوْ لَمْ تَكُنْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ لَكَفَى بِهَا حُجَّةً عَلَيْهِمْ: {فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ {161} مَا أَنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَاتِنِينَ {162} إِلا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ الْجَحِيمِ {163} } [الصافات: 161-163] ،
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Anas b. 'Iyad informed me
records.matn_en: that a man of the Qadariyya said: “With us are 'Abd Allah b. Yazid b. Hurmuz and 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz.” Ibn Hurmuz was asked and said: “He lies, by God! I knew Medina and no one was mentioned in it but one man of Juhayna called Ma'bad.” He said: Then I asked Abu Suhayl, the uncle of Malik b. Anas, and he said: “He lies. 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz consulted me and said to me: What do you think of those who deny al-qadar? I said: I think they should be asked to repent; if they repent, [well]; otherwise I would strike their necks. 'Umar said: That is the opinion about them. By God, if there were no other verse than this, it would suffice as an argument against them: {For indeed, you and what you worship (161) Cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him (162) Except he who will [enter and] burn in the Hellfire (163)} [al-Saffat 37:161-163].”

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: Abu Suhayl b. Malik (via Anas b. 'Iyad) (successor)

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ مَوْلَى غَفْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سُهَيْلِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ذَلِكَ:
records.matn_ar: وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الآيَةَ
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: al-Layth b. Sa'd informed me, from 'Umar, mawla of Ghufra, from Abu Suhayl b. Malik, from 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz, that he said that;
records.matn_en: but he did not mention the verse.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

groups.title_en: Chapter on the apostate from Islam

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، وَهِشَامُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، وَدَاوُدُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ، أَنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ أَسْلَمَ حَدَّثَهُمْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﵇ قَالَ: «
records.matn_ar: مَنْ غَيَّرَ دِينَهُ فَاقْتُلُوهُ» ،
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Malik b. Anas, Hisham b. Sa'd and Dawud b. Qays informed me that Zayd b. Aslam narrated to them that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever changes his religion, kill him.”

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

remarks.ar: قَالَ مَالِكٌ: فَإِنَّمَا يَعْنِي بِذَلِكَ مَنْ خَرَجَ مِنَ الإِسْلامِ وَكَفَرَ بِاللَّهِ، وَلَمْ يَعْنِ بِذَلِكَ مَنِ انْتَقَلَ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ وَالنَّصَارَى وَالْمَجُوسِ إِلَى دِينٍ آخَرَ، أَنْ يَتَهَوَّدَ النَّصْرَانِيُّ أَوْ يَتَنَصَّرَ الْيَهُودِيُّ أَوِ الْمَجُوسِيُّ
remarks.en: Malik said: By that he only means whoever leaves Islam and disbelieves in God; he does not mean by it one who moves from the Jews, Christians or Magians to another religion, such as a Christian becoming a Jew, or a Jew or Magian becoming a Christian.

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ مَنْ أَخْبَرَهُ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ كَتَبَ إِلَى عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ يَسْأَلَهُ عَنْ نَصْرَانِيٍّ تَحَوَّلَ يَهُودِيًّا أَوْ مَجُوسِيًّا، أَوْ يَهُودِيٍّ تَحَوَّلَ نَصْرَانِيًّا أَوْ مَجُوسِيًّا، قَالَ: فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ: إِنَّمَا تَحَوُلٌّ مِنْ كُفْرٍ إِلَى كُفْرٍ، لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: 'Abd Allah b. Yazid informed me, from one who informed him, from Simak b. Harb,
records.matn_en: that Muhammad b. Abi Bakr wrote to 'Ali b. Abi Talib asking him about a Christian who turned Jew or Magian, or a Jew who turned Christian or Magian. He wrote to him: “It is only a conversion from unbelief to unbelief; nothing is upon him.”

narrators.en: A man (not named in the text)
'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، وَابْنُ سَمْعَانَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﵇ قَالَ: «
records.matn_ar: مَنْ كَفَرَ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ إِيمَانِهِ طَائِعًا فَاقْتُلُوهُ» ،
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: 'Amr b. al-Harith and Ibn Sam'an informed me that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever disbelieves in God after his belief, willingly, kill him.”

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

remarks.ar: قَالَ ابْنُ سَمْعَانَ: وَلا أَعْلَمُ إِلا أَنَّ نَافِعًا، وَزَيْدَ بْنَ أَسْلَمَ حَدَّثَانِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ
remarks.en: Ibn Sam'an said: I only know that Nafi' and Zayd b. Aslam narrated this hadith to me.

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي الْحَارِثُ بْنُ نَبْهَانَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ السَّخْتِيَانِيُّ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﵇ قَالَ: «
records.matn_ar: مَنْ بَدَّلَ دِينَهُ فَاقْتُلُوهُ، وَلا تُعَذِّبُوا بِعَذَابِ اللَّهِ»
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: al-Harith b. Nabhan informed me, from Ayyub al-Sakhtiyani, from 'Ikrima, from Ibn 'Abbas, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever changes his religion, kill him, and do not punish with the punishment of God.”

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، وَابْنُ سَمْعَانَ ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: هَاجَتِ الْفِتْنَةُ الأُولَى فَأَدْرَكَتْ رِجَالا ذَوِي عَدَدٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ مِمَّنْ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﵇، فَبَلَغَنَا أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا يَرَوْنَ أَنْ يُهْدَمَ أَمْرُ الْفِتْنَةِ فَلا يُقَامُ فِيهَا عَلَى رَجُلٍ قَاتِلٍ فِي تَأْوِيلِ الْقُرْآنِ قِصَاصٌ فِيمَنْ قَتَلَ، وَلا حَدٌّ فِي سَبْيِ امْرَأَةٍ سُبِيَتْ، وَلا نَرَى عَلَيْهِ حَدًّا، وَلا نَرَى بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ زَوْجِهَا مُلاعَنَةً، وَلا نَرَى أَنْ يَقْذِفَهَا أَحَدٌ إِلا جُلِدَ الْحَدَّ، وَنَرَى أَنْ تُرَدَّ إِلَى زَوْجِهَا الأَوَّلِ بَعْدَ أَنْ تَعْتَدَّ فَتَنْقَضِي عِدَّتُهَا مِنْ زَوْجِهَا الآخَرِ، وَنَرَى أَنْ تَرِثَ زَوْجَهَا الأَوَّلَ
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Yunus b. Yazid and Ibn Sam'an informed me, from Ibn Shihab, that he said:
records.matn_en: The first fitna broke out and caught a number of the Companions of the Messenger of God ﷺ who had been present at Badr with the Messenger of God ﷺ. It has reached us that they held that the matter of the fitna should be set aside, so that no retaliation is applied in it against a man who killed on the basis of an interpretation of the Qur'an, nor any hadd for [taking] a woman captive, and we do not see a hadd upon him; nor do we see li'an between her and her husband; nor do we see that anyone may accuse her without being flogged the hadd; and we hold that she is returned to her first husband after she observes the waiting period and her waiting period from the other husband ends; and we hold that she inherits from her first husband.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: Ibn Shihab al-Zuhri (reporting the view of Badr Companions) (later authority)

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ رِجَالٍ شَهِدُوا بَدْرًا
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا يَقُولُونَ: لَوْ أَنَّ رَجُلا تَأَوَّلَ مَعَ الْحَرُورِيَّةِ فَقَاتَلَ وَقُتِلَ، ثُمَّ مَاتَ، أَوِ امْرَأَةً تَأَوَّلَتِ الْقُرْآنَ فَخَرَجَتْ حَتَّى لَحِقَتْ بِالْخَوَارِجِ وَتَرَكَتْ زَوْجَهَا وَقَاتَلَتْ مَعَهُمْ وَتَزَوَّجَتْ فِيهِمْ، ثُمَّ جَاءَتْ تَائِبَةً لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَيْهَا حَدٌّ، وَكَانَ عَلَى مَنْ قَذَفَهَا الْحَدُّ، وَلَمْ تَكُنْ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ زَوْجِهَا مُلاعَنَةٌ، وَحُبِسَتْ عَنْ زَوْجِهَا حَتَّى تُسْتَبْرَأَ، ثُمَّ تَرْجِعَ إِلَى زَوْجِهَا الأَوَّلِ
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Ibn Abi Dhi'b informed me, from Ibn Shihab, from men who had been present at Badr,
records.matn_en: that they used to say: If a man interpreted [the Qur'an] with the Haruriyya and fought and killed, and then died; or a woman interpreted the Qur'an and went out and joined the Khawarij, leaving her husband, and fought with them and married among them, and then came repentant, there would be no hadd upon her, and the hadd would be upon whoever accused her; there would be no li'an between her and her husband; she would be kept from her husband until her womb is cleared, then return to her first husband.

narrators.en: Men who were present at Badr (not named)
'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: Men who were present at Badr (companion)

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ سَمْعَانَ يَقُولُ: أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ الْفُرْقَةَ وَقَعَتْ بَعْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﵇ وَأَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ مُتَوَافِرُونَ، فَاجْتَمَعَ الأَمْرُ فِيهِمْ أَلا يُحَدَّ فَرْجٌ اسْتُحِلَّ بِتَأْوِيلِ الْقُرْآنِ، وَلا يُقَادَ وَلا يُودَى مَا اسْتُحِلَّ بِتَأْوِيلِ الْقُرْآنِ وَلا يُضْمَنَ مَالٌ ذَهَبَ إِلا إِنْ يُضْمَنْ شَيْءٌ بِعَيْنِهِ فَيُرَدَّ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: I heard Ibn Sam'an say: Ibn Shihab informed me
records.matn_en: that the division occurred after the Messenger of God ﷺ while the Companions of the Prophet were numerous, and the matter was agreed among them that no hadd is to be applied for a sexual relation made lawful by an interpretation of the Qur'an, nor retaliation or blood-money for what was made lawful by an interpretation of the Qur'an, nor liability for property lost, except that a thing identified in itself is liable and is returned to its owners.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: The Companions (as reported by Ibn Shihab) (companion)

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ سَمْعَانَ أَنَّ مَنْ أُدْرِكَ مِنَ السَّلَفِ
records.matn_ar: كَانُوا يَقُولُونَ: هُمَا رِدَّتَانِ، رِدَّةُ كُفْرٍ يُسْتَحَلُّ بِهَا الْقَتْلُ وَالسَّبْيُ وَقَطْعُ الْمَوَارِيثُ، وَرِدَّةُ انْتِقَاضِ شَرَائِعِ الإِسْلامِ، فَقَاتَلَ عَلَيْهَا أَهْلُهَا لا يَحِلُّ سَبْيُهُمْ وَلا أَخْذُ أَمْوَالُهُمْ، وَهِيَ سِيرَةُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ فِي مَنِ ارْتَدَّ فِي زَمَانِهِ
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Ibn Sam'an informed me that those he met of the early generations
records.matn_en: used to say: There are two kinds of apostasy: an apostasy of unbelief by which killing, enslavement and the cutting off of inheritances become lawful; and an apostasy of violating the laws of Islam, for which its people are fought, but their enslavement and the taking of their property are not lawful. And this is the practice of Abu Bakr al-Siddiq regarding those who apostatized in his time.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: Early generations (as reported by Ibn Sam'an) (later authority)

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي الْحَارِثُ بْنُ نَبْهَانَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ السَّخْتِيَانِيِّ يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنَ عُلاثَةَ ارْتَدَّ عِنْدَ وَفَاةِ النَّبِيِّ ﵇ فَانْطَلَقَ حَتَّى لَحِقَ بِهِرَقْلَ أَوْ بِقَيْصَرَ، فَأَرْسَلَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقُ إِلَى امْرَأَتِهِ وَابْنَتِهِ وَخَيَّرَهُنَّ، فَقَالَتِ امْرَأَتُهُ: إِنْ كَانَ عَلْقَمَةُ كَفَرَ مَا كَفَرْتُ أَنَا وَلا ابْنَتِي، فَتَرَكَهُنَّ، فَقَدِمَ عَلْقَمَةُ فِي خِلافَةِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، فَجَعَلَ يَشُدُّ عَلَيْهِ فِي الْقَوْلِ، فَقَالَ: حَسْبُكَ سَائِرَ الْيَوْمِ، بَايِعْنِي
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: al-Harith b. Nabhan informed me, from Ayyub al-Sakhtiyani, narrating from Ibn Sirin,
records.matn_en: that 'Alqama b. 'Ulatha apostatized at the death of the Prophet ﷺ and set out until he joined Heraclius or Caesar. Abu Bakr al-Siddiq sent to his wife and daughter and gave them a choice; his wife said: “If 'Alqama has disbelieved, I have not disbelieved, nor has my daughter.” So he left them. Then 'Alqama came back in the caliphate of 'Umar b. al-Khattab, and he began to press him with words; he said: “Enough for the rest of the day; pledge allegiance to me.”

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ قَالَ: كَتَبَ إِلَيَّ رَبِيعَةُ
records.matn_ar: فِي أَهْلِ قَرْيَةٍ أَسْلَمُوا وَأَسْلَمَ نِسَاؤُهُمْ وَذَرَارِيُّهُمْ، ثُمَّ ارْتَدُّوا عَنِ الإِسْلامِ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَكَفَرُوا وَقَاتَلُوا فَقُتِلَتْ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْهُمْ وَأُسِرَتْ طَائِفَةٌ، فَهَلْ يَحِلُّ سَبْيُهُمْ أَمْ لا يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يُقْبَلَ مِنْهُمْ إِلا الإِسْلامُ، فَقَالَ رَبِيعَةَ: يُقْتَلُ الرِّجَالُ وَالنِّسَاءُ وَكُلُّ مَنْ بَلَغَ مِنَ الذَّرِيَّةِ مِنْ رَجُلٍ أَوِ امْرَأَةٍ صَاغِرًا قَمِئًا، إِلا كُلَّ ذَرِيَّةٍ وُلِدَتْ بَعْدَ أَنْ أَسْلَمُوا، ثُمَّ كَفَرُوا وَقَاتَلُوا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَبْلُغَ تِلْكَ الذَّرِيَّةُ بِكَامِلِ السِّنِّ الَّتِي تَقَعُ عِنْدَهَا الْحُدُودُ وَتَكَامُلُ الْفَرَائِضِ، وَذَلِكَ لأَنَّهُمْ وُلِدُوا فِي حُجُورِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلأَنَّهُمْ وُلِدُوا فِي حُجُورٍ مُسْلِمَةٍ، فَلَيْسَ لَهُمْ أَنْ يَنْقُضُوا عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَمْ يَبْلُغُوا السِّنَّ، فَيَكُونُوا هُمْ نَقَضُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ، فَأُولَئِكَ مُسْلِمُونَ أَحْرَارًا. أَمَّا كُلُّ ذَرِيَّةٍ وُلِدَتْ فِي حُجُورِهِمْ وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ ثُمَّ أَسْلَمُوا فَكَانُوا عَلَى ذَرَارِيِّهِمْ وَأَنْفُسِهِمْ ثُمَّ نَقَضُوا فَقَدْ نَقَضُوا عَنْ مَنْ دَخَلَ فِي الإِسْلامِ أَدْخَلُوهُمْ، وَكَانَ فِي الْكُفْرِ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ مَعَهُمْ، فَقَدْ نَقَضُوا عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَخْرَجُوهُمْ كَمَا كَانُوا أَدْخَلُوهُمْ فَأُولَئِكَ يُسْبَوْنَ، لَيْسُوا كَهِبَةِ مَنْ وُلِدَ بَعْدَ إِسْلامِهِمْ وَلَمْ يُدْرَكْ حَتَّى نَقَضُوا، إِسْلامُ تِلْكَ الذَّرِيَّةِ إِسْلامُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ كُلِّهِمْ ، فَهُمْ أَحْرَارٌ وَلا يُسْبَوْنَ.
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: al-Layth b. Sa'd informed me; he said: Rabi'a wrote to me
records.matn_en: about the people of a village who became Muslim, and their women and offspring became Muslim, and then they apostatized from Islam afterwards, disbelieved and fought, so that a group of them was killed and a group captured: is their enslavement lawful, or should nothing but Islam be accepted from them? Rabi'a said: The men and women are killed, and every one of the offspring who reached adulthood, man or woman, in humiliation and abasement; except every offspring born after they became Muslims, then disbelieved and fought, before that offspring reached the full age at which the hudud apply and the obligations are complete; because they were born in the care of believers, in Muslim care; they have no power to break against them while they had not reached the age, so that they would have broken it upon themselves; those are free Muslims. But every offspring born in their care while they were unbelievers, then they became Muslims and they were upon their offspring and themselves, then they broke [it], they have broken it for those they had brought into Islam, who had been in unbelief before that with them; so they broke it against them and took them out as they had brought them in; those are enslaved; they are not like those born after their Islam, who did not reach [maturity] until they broke it. The Islam of that offspring is the Islam of all Muslims; so they are free and are not enslaved.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ سَعْدٍ كَانَ قَدِ ارْتَدَّ عَنِ الإِسْلامِ فَأَمَرَ النَّبِيَّ ﵇ بِقَتْلِهِ إِنْ وُجِدَ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْفَتْحِ اسْتَجَارَ بِعُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ وَكَانَ أَخَاهُ مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ ، فَاسْتَجَارَ لَهُ عُثْمَانُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﵇ قَالَ: فَسَكَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ سَاعَةً ، ثُمَّ كَلَّمَهُ عُثْمَانُ فِيهِ ، فَآمَنَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﵇، فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، ائْذَنْ لِي فِيهِ أَضْرِبَ عُنُقَهُ، فَقَالَ: الآنَ، أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ سَكَتُّ، فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، انْتَظَرْتُ أَنْ تُومِئَ إِلَيَّ ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: لا يَحِلُّ لِنَبِيٍّ أَنْ يُومِئَ
records.isnad_en: 'Abd Allah b. Lahi'a informed me, from al-Harith b. Yazid al-Hadrami,
records.matn_en: that 'Abd Allah b. Sa'd had apostatized from Islam, and the Prophet ordered that he be killed if found. On the day of the Conquest he sought the protection of 'Uthman b. 'Affan, who was his foster brother; 'Uthman sought protection for him from the Messenger of God ﷺ. He said: The Messenger of God was silent for a while; then 'Uthman spoke to him about him, and the Messenger of God ﷺ granted him safety. A man of the Ansar stood and said: “O Messenger of God, permit me to strike his neck.” He said: “Now? Did you not see how I was silent?” He said: “O Messenger of God, I waited for you to signal to me.” The Messenger of God said: “It is not lawful for a prophet to signal [with the eye].”

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: The Prophet ﷺ (account by al-Harith b. Yazid al-Hadrami) (prophetic)

records.isnad_ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﵇ قَالَ: «
records.matn_ar: لا يَحِلُّ لِنَبِيٍّ أَنْ يُومِئَ»
records.isnad_en: And 'Abd Allah b. Lahi'a narrated to me, from Yazid b. Abi Habib, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “It is not lawful for a prophet to signal.”

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، وَغَيْرِهِ ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ الأَشْعَثَ بْنَ قَيْسٍ الْكِنْدِيَّ كَانَ أَسْلَمَ فِي زَمَانِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﵇ وَقَدِمَ عَلَيْهِ ، فَلَمَّا ارْتَدَّتِ الْعَرَبُ بَعْدَ وَفَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﵇ ارْتَدَّ فِيمَنِ ارْتَدَّ، فَلَمَّا قَاتَلَهُمْ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَقَتَلَ قَوْمَ الأَشْعَثِ فَأُتِيَ بِهِ أَسِيرًا إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ، قَالَ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ: إِنْ رَأَيْتَ أَنْ تَسْتَبْقِيَنِي عَلَى الْعَدُوِّ أَوْ تَنْكِحَنِي أُخْتَكَ أُمَّ فَرْوَةَ بِنْتَ أَبِي قُحَافَةَ، قَالَ: فَاسْتَبْقَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَأَنْكَحَهُ أُخْتَهُ، فَوَلَدَتْ مِنْهُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ الأَشْعَثِ
records.isnad_en: And Ibn Lahi'a narrated to me, from Yazid b. Abi Habib and others,
records.matn_en: that al-Ash'ath b. Qays al-Kindi had become Muslim in the time of the Messenger of God ﷺ and had come to him. When the Arabs apostatized after the death of the Messenger of God ﷺ he apostatized among those who apostatized. When Abu Bakr fought them and killed the people of al-Ash'ath, and he was brought to Abu Bakr as a captive, he said to Abu Bakr: “If you see fit to spare me against the enemy, or to marry me to your sister Umm Farwa daughter of Abu Quhafa.” So Abu Bakr spared him and married him to his sister, and she bore him Muhammad b. al-Ash'ath.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: Yazid b. Abi Habib and others (successor)

records.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَيْضًا
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ قَالَ لِلأَشْعَثِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ: إِنِّي لأَرَى فِي عَقِبِكَ غَدْرَهُ يَوْمَ النَّجِيرِ ، قَالَ: فَكَانَ ابْنُهُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الأَشْعَثِ افْتُتِنَ فِي زَمَانِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ مَرْوَانَ ، فَخَرَجَ عَلَى الْحَجَّاجِ بْنِ يُوسُفَ فَقَاتَلَهُ سَنَتَيْنِ أَوْ نَحْوَ ذَلِكَ ، ثُمَّ انْهَزَمَ بَعْدُ فَهَلَكَ.
records.isnad_en: He said: And he also narrated to me
records.matn_en: that 'Ali b. Abi Talib said to al-Ash'ath b. Qays: “I see treachery in your progeny on the day of al-Nujayr.” He said: So his son 'Abd al-Rahman b. Muhammad b. al-Ash'ath was tempted into fitna in the time of 'Abd al-Malik b. Marwan, and rose against al-Hajjaj b. Yusuf and fought him for two years or so, then was defeated afterwards and perished.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: 'Ali b. Abi Talib (with a later note on the outcome) (companion)

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي مَسْلَمَةُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ ، عَنْ غَيْرِ وَاحِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﵇ بِنَبْهَانَ أَسِيرًا فَأَسْلَمَ ، فَخَلَّى سَبِيلَهُ فَكَفَرَ ، ثُمَّ أُتِيَ بِهِ فَأَسْلَمَ ، ثُمَّ كَفَرَ، أَرْبَعًا أَوْ خَمْسًا ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ أَمْكِنِّي مِنْ نَبْهَانَ فِي حَبْلٍ أَبْرَقَ ، فَتَغَيَّرَ حَبْلُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﵇ ، فَأَتَوْا بِهِ فِي حَبْلٍ أَبْرَقَ ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﵇: اضْرِبُوا عُنُقَهُ ، فَلَمَّا وَلِيَ قَالَ: مَا يُرِيدُ مِنِّي ابْنُ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ ، فَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ أَلَّا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ، قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﵇: مَا يَقُولُ؟ فَأَخْبَرُوهُ بِقَوْلِهِ ، فَخَلَّى سَبِيلَهُ
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Maslama b. 'Ali informed me, from more than one, from Ibn Shihab, who said:
records.matn_en: Nabhan was brought as a captive to the Messenger of God ﷺ and became Muslim; he released him; then he disbelieved. He was brought again and became Muslim, then disbelieved, four or five times. Then he said: “O God, give me power over Nabhan on a mottled (abraq) rope.” The rope of the Messenger of God changed; so they brought him on a mottled rope. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Strike his neck.” When he turned away, he said: “What does the son of 'Abd al-Muttalib want from me? I bear witness that there is no god but God and that Muhammad is the Messenger of God.” The Prophet ﷺ said: “What is he saying?” They told him what he said, and he released him.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: The Prophet ﷺ (report by Ibn Shihab) (prophetic)

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي سُفْيَانُ الثَّوْرِيُّ ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ اللَّيْثِيِّ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﵇ اسْتَتَابَ نَبْهَانَ أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ ، وَكَانَ نَبْهَانُ قَدِ ارْتَدَّ
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Sufyan al-Thawri informed me, from a man, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Ubayd b. 'Umayr al-Laythi,
records.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ asked Nabhan to repent four times, and Nabhan had apostatized.

narrators.ar: عبد الله بن عبيد بن عمير الليثي

narrators.en: A man (not named in the text)
'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: الْمُرْتَدُّ يُسْتَتَابُ أَبَدًا كُلَّمَا رَجَعَ
records.isnad_en: Sufyan said: And 'Umar b. Qays informed me, from Ibrahim b. Yazid, that he said:
records.matn_en: The apostate is asked to repent forever, whenever he returns.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَسَأَلْتُ مَالِكًا فَقَالَ لِي:
records.matn_ar: يُسْتَتَابُ كُلَّمَا رَجَعَ. قَالَ مَالِكٌ: وَقَدْ قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ: أَلا اسْتَتَبْتُمُوهُ ثَلاثًا.
records.isnad_en: He said: And I asked Malik, and he said to me:
records.matn_en: He is asked to repent whenever he returns. Malik said: And 'Umar b. al-Khattab said: “Why did you not ask him to repent three times?”

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقَ أَمَرَ خَالِدَ بْنَ الْوَلِيدِ حِينَ بَعَثَهُ إِلَى مَنِ ارْتَدَّ مِنَ الْعَرَبِ أَنْ يَدْعُوَهُمْ بِدِعَايَةِ الإِسْلامِ وَيُنَبِّئَهُمْ بِالَّذِي لَهُمْ فِيهِ وَعَلَيْهِمْ وَيَحْرِصَ عَلَى هُدَاهُمْ ، فَمَنْ أَجَابَهُ مِنَ النَّاسِ كُلِّهِمْ أَحْمَرِهِمْ وَأَسْوَدِهِمْ فَلْيَقْبَلْ ذَلِكَ مِنْهُ ، فَإِنَّهُ إِنَّمَا يُقَاتِلُ مَنْ كَفَرَ بِاللَّهِ عَلَى الإِيمَانِ بِاللَّهِ ، فَإِذَا أَجَابَ الْمَدْعُو إِلَى الإِسْلامِ وَصَدَقَ إِيمَانُهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَيْهِ سَبِيلٌ ، وَكَانَ اللَّهُ هُوَ حَسْبُهُ ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يُجِبْهُ إِلَى مَا دَعَاهُ إِلَيْهِ مِنَ الإِسْلامِ مِمَّنْ رَجَعَ عَنْهُ أَنْ يَقْتُلَهُ
records.isnad_en: He said: And Ibn Lahi'a informed me, from Abu al-Aswad Muhammad b. 'Abd al-Rahman, from 'Urwa b. al-Zubayr,
records.matn_en: that Abu Bakr al-Siddiq commanded Khalid b. al-Walid, when he sent him to those of the Arabs who had apostatized, to call them with the call of Islam, inform them of what is for them and against them, and be eager for their guidance; whoever of the people responded to him, all of them, red and black, he should accept that from him; for he fights only those who disbelieve in God over belief in God. When the one called responds to Islam and his belief is true, there is no recourse against him, and God is his reckoner. And whoever does not respond to what he calls him to of Islam, among those who returned from it, he kills him.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: 'Urwa b. al-Zubayr (account of Abu Bakr's instruction) (successor)

records.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ ، وَيَعْقُوبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الزُّهْرِيُّ ، وَمَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْقَارِي ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَدِمَ عَلَيْهِ رَجُلٌ مِنْ قِبَلِ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنِ النَّاسِ فَأَخْبَرَهُ ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: هَلْ كَانَ فِيكُمْ مَنْ مُغَرِّبَةِ خَبَرٍ ، قَالَ: نَعَمْ ، رَجُلٌ كَفَرَ بَعْدَ إِسْلامِهِ قَالَ: فَمَاذَا فَعَلْتُمْ بِهِ، قَالَ: قَرَّبْنَاهُ فَضَرَبْنَا عُنُقَهُ ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: فَهَلا حَبَسْتُمُوهُ ثَلاثًا وَطَيَّنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بَيْتًا ، وَأَطْعَمْتُمُوهُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ رَغِيفًا وَاسْتَتَبْتُمُوهُ لَعَلَّهُ يَتُوبُ وَيُرَاجِعُ أَمْرَ اللَّهِ ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي لَمْ أَحْضُرْ ، وَلَمْ آمُرْ ، وَلَمْ أَرْضَ إِذْ بَلَغَنِي،
records.isnad_en: He said: And Yahya b. 'Abd Allah b. Salim, Ya'qub b. 'Abd al-Rahman al-Zuhri and Malik b. Anas narrated to me, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Muhammad b. 'Abd al-Qari, from his father, from his grandfather, from 'Umar b. al-Khattab,
records.matn_en: that a man came to him from Abu Musa al-Ash'ari and he asked him about the people, and he told him; then he said: “Was there among you any strange news?” He said: “Yes: a man disbelieved after his Islam.” He said: “What did you do with him?” He said: “We brought him near and struck his neck.” 'Umar said: “Why did you not imprison him for three days, shut him in a house of clay, feed him a loaf of bread every day, and ask him to repent, so that he might repent and return to the command of God? O God, I was not present, I did not command, and I was not pleased when it reached me.”

narrators.en: Grandfather of 'Abd al-Rahman b. Muhammad b. 'Abd al-Qari (not named in the text)
Father of 'Abd al-Rahman b. Muhammad b. 'Abd al-Qari (not named in the text)

narrators.ar: عبد الرحمن بن محمد بن عبد القاري
يحيى بن عبد الله بن سالم

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري
