records.isnad_ar: وَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي جَائِفَةِ الْعَبْدِ وَمَأْمُومَتِهِ وَمنْقلَتِهِ وَمُوضِحَتِهِ:
records.matn_ar: إِنَّمَا ذَلِكَ كُلُّهُ فِي ثَمَنِهِ، وَهُوَ سَلْعَةٌ مِنَ السِّلَعِ يَرْتَفِعُ وَيَنْخَفِضُ
records.isnad_en: And Ibn Lahi'a informed me, from Rabi'a b. Abi 'Abd al-Rahman, from Sa'id b. al-Musayyab, that he said about the slave's ja'ifa, ma'muma, munaqqila and mawdiha:
records.matn_en: All of that is only in his price; he is a commodity among commodities that rises and falls.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قَالَ اللَّهُ: {الْحُرُّ بِالْحُرِّ وَالْعَبْدُ بِالْعَبْدِ وَالأُنْثَى بِالأُنْثَى} [البقرة: 178] فَإِذَا قَتَلَ الْعَبْدُ الْعَبْدَ عَمْدًا خُيِّرَ سَيِّدُ الْعَبْدِ الْمَقْتُولِ، فَإِنْ شَاءَ قَتَلَ الْعَبْدَ الْقَاتِلَ، وَإِنْ كَانَ أَفْضَلَ مِنْهُ بِأَضْعَافٍ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ قَبِلَ الْعَقْلَ، فَإِنْ أَخَذَ الْعَقْلَ أَخَذَ قِيمَةَ عَبْدِهِ الْمَقْتُولِ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ أَرْبَابُ الْعَبْدِ الْقَاتِلِ أَنْ يُعْطُوهُ ثَمَنَ الْعَبْدِ الْمَقْتُولِ فَعَلُوا، وَإِنْ أَسْلَمُوا عَبْدَهُمْ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِمْ إِلا ذَلِكَ، وَلَيْسَ لأَرْبَابِ الْعَبْدِ الْمَقْتُولِ، إِذَا أَخَذُوا الْعَبْدَ الْقَاتِلَ وَرَضُوا بِالْعَقْلِ، أَنْ يَقْتُلُوا الْعَبْدَ الْقَاتِلَ الَّذِي يَأْخُذُونَ. قَالَ: وَذَلِكَ فِي الْقِصَاصِ كُلِّهِ بَيْنَ الْعَبْدَيْنِ فِي الْقَتْلِ وَفِي قَطْعِ الْيَدِ وَالرِّجْلِ وَأَشْبَاهِ ذَلِكَ.
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Malik b. Anas informed me; he said:
records.matn_en: God said: {The free for the free, the slave for the slave, and the female for the female} [al-Baqara 2:178]. So if a slave kills a slave intentionally, the master of the slain slave is given the choice: if he wishes he kills the killer slave, even if he is many times better than him; and if he wishes he accepts the blood-money; if he takes the blood-money he takes the value of his slain slave; and if the owners of the killer slave wish to give him the price of the slain slave they may; and if they surrender their slave they owe nothing but that. The owners of the slain slave, if they take the killer slave and are satisfied with the blood-money, may not kill the killer slave whom they take. He said: And that applies to retaliation of all kinds between two slaves, in killing, in cutting a hand or foot and the like.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكٌ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: الأَمْرُ الْمُجْتَمَعُ عَلَيْهِ عِنْدَنَا أَنَّ الْعَبْدَ إِذَا جَرَحَ بِزَّةً لا يَعْقِلُهُ إِلا سَيِّدُهُ، كُلُّ جُرْحٍ جَرَحَهُ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ قَتْلٍ أَوْ غَيْرِهِ فَسَيِّدُهُ فِي ذَلِكَ بِالْخِيَارِ: إِنْ شَاءَ أَنْ يَجْرَحَ ذَلِكَ الْعَقْلَ وَيَمْسِكَ غُلامَهُ فَعَلَ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ أَنْ يُسَلِّمَ عَبْدَهُ أَسْلَمَهُ ، وَلا يَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ إِلا ذَلِكَ، وَلَيْسَ عَلَى السَّيِّدِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ثَمَنِ عَبْدِهِ فِيمَا أَصَابَ بِهِ مِنَ الْجِرَاحَاتِ.
records.isnad_en: He said: And Malik informed me; he said:
records.matn_en: The matter agreed upon with us is that when a slave wounds [a person] [bizza(?)], none but his master pays for him; for every wound the slave inflicts, of killing or other, his master has the choice: if he wishes to pay that blood-money and keep his slave boy he may, and if he wishes to surrender his slave he surrenders him and nothing else is upon him; the master owes no more than the price of his slave for the wounds he inflicted.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَسَمِعْتُ مَالِكًا يَقُولُ فِيمَنْ كَانَ لَهُ عَبْدٌ وَلَهُ مَالٌ فَجُرِحَ الْعَبْدُ،
records.matn_ar: إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ وَمَالَهُ لِصَاحِبِ الْجُرْحِ مَعَ رَقَبَتِهِ فِي جَرِيرَتِهِ إِلا أَنْ يُقِيدَ بِهِ سَيِّدُهُ.
records.isnad_en: He said: And I heard Malik say about one who had a slave who had property, and the slave was wounded [sic; perhaps: wounded someone]:
records.matn_en: that the slave and his property belong to the one wounded, along with his person, for his offense, unless his master gives retaliation for him.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكٌ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: الأَمْرُ عِنْدَنَا فِي الْقِصَاصِ فِي الْمَمَالِيكِ بَيْنَهُمْ كَهَيْئَتِهِ فِي الأَحْرَارِ، نَفْسُ الأَمَةِ بِنَفْسِ الْعَبِيدِ وَجَرْحُهَا بِجَرْحِهِ، قَالَ: وَأَقَادَهُ الْعَبِيدُ بَعْضُهُمْ مِنْ بَعْضٍ فِي الْجِرَاحِ، يُخَيَّرُ سَيِّدُ الْمَجْرُوحِ: إِنْ شَاءَ اسْتَقَادَ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ أَخَذَ الْعَقْلَ.
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Malik informed me; he said:
records.matn_en: The practice with us regarding retaliation among slaves is as it is among free people: the person of the slave girl for the person of slaves and her wound for his wound. He said: And slaves retaliate against one another in wounds; the master of the wounded one is given the choice: if he wishes he takes retaliation, and if he wishes he takes the blood-money.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي مَخْرَمَةُ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَابِرٍ يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ يَقُولُ: إِذَا قَتَلَ الْعَبْدُ الْعَبْدَ عَمْدًا فَهُوَ بِهِ، وَإِذَا قَتَلَهُ خَطَأً فَإِنْ كَانَ الْقَاتِلُ هُوَ أَغْلَى ثَمَنًا مِنَ الْمَقْتُولِ أُقِيمَ الْمَقْتُولُ قِيمَةَ عَدْلٍ، ثُمَّ أُعْطُوا ثَمَنَهُ، وَإِنْ كَانَ الْمَقْتُولُ هُوَ أَفْضَلُ مِنَ الْقَاتِلِ لَمْ يَكُنْ لأَهْلِ الْمَقْتُولِ إِلا قَاتِلِ عَبْدِهِمْ، قَالَ بُكَيْرٌ: وَقَالَ ذَلِكَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Makhrama b. Bukayr informed me, from his father, who said: I heard Sa'id b. 'Abd Allah b. Jabir say:
records.matn_en: I heard 'Urwa b. al-Zubayr say: If a slave kills a slave intentionally, he is [killed] for him; if he kills him by mistake, then if the killer is higher in price than the slain, the slain is valued with a just valuation and they are given his price; and if the slain was better than the killer, the family of the slain have only the killer of their slave. Bukayr said: And Ibn Shihab said that.

narrators.ar: سعيد بن عبد الله بن جابر

narrators.en: Bukayr b. 'Abd Allah b. al-Ashajj (father of Makhrama)
'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي مَمْلُوكَيْنِ قَتَلا مَمْلُوكًا عَمْدًا، فَأَرَادَ وَلِيُّ الْمَقْتُولِ أَنْ يَسْتَرِقَّهُمَا وَلا يَقْتُلَهُمَا،
records.matn_ar: قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ: إِنْ قَتَلَهُمَا قَوْدًا خَلَّى بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ قَتْلِهِمَا، وَإِنْ أَرَادَ اسْتِرْقَاقَهُمَا، وَاسْتِحْيَاءَهُمَا فَلَيْسَ لَهُ فِيهِمَا إِلا ثَمَنُ مَا أَصَابَا
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Yunus b. Yazid informed me, from Ibn Shihab, that he said regarding two slaves who killed a slave intentionally, whereupon the guardian of the slain wanted to enslave them and not kill them:
records.matn_en: Ibn Shihab said: If he kills them in retaliation, he is let to kill them; and if he wishes to enslave them and spare them, he has nothing from them but the price of what they did.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: وَقَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ فِي حُرٍّ وَعَبْدٍ قَتَلا حُرًّا أَوْ عَبْدًا عَمْدًا،
records.matn_ar: قَالَ: سُنَّتُهُمَا سنة إِلَى قَوْمِهِمَا.
records.isnad_en: And Ibn Shihab said, regarding a free man and a slave who killed a free man or a slave intentionally:
records.matn_en: He said: Their sunna is a sunna [applied] to their peoples.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: ابْنَ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ نَوْفَلِ بْنِ مُسَاحِقٍ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُقِيدُ الْعَبِيدَ بَعْضَهُمْ مِنْ بَعْضٍ
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Ibn Abi Dhi'b informed me, from al-Harith b. 'Abd al-Rahman, from Nawfal b. Musahiq,
records.matn_en: that he used to apply retaliation among slaves against one another.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: وَأَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ: كَتَبَ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ الْعَبْدَيْنِ قِصَاصٌ فِي الْعَمْدِ أَنْفُسُهُمَا، فَمَا دُونَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ جِرَاحِهِمَا. قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ: وَقَالَ ذَلِكَ سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، أَنَّ فِي كِتَابٍ لِعُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: يُقَادُ الْمَمْلُوكُ مِنَ الْمَمْلُوكِ فِي كُلِّ عَمْدٍ يَبْلُغُ نَفْسَهُ، فَمَا دُونَ ذَلِكَ مِنَ الْجِرَاحِ فَإِنِ اصْطَلَحُوا فِيهِ عَلَى الْعَقْلِ فَقِيمَةُ الْمَقْتُولِ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْقَاتِلِ أَوِ الْجَارِحِ
records.isnad_en: And Muhammad b. 'Amr informed me, from Ibn Jurayj, who said: 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz wrote
records.matn_en: that two slaves are subject to retaliation in intentional [killing], their persons and what is less than that of their wounds. Ibn Jurayj said: Salim b. 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar also said that. Ibn Jurayj said: And 'Abd al-'Aziz b. 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz informed me that in a letter of 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz, from 'Umar b. al-Khattab, he said: A slave is retaliated against for a slave in every intentional [act] that reaches the person; as for wounds less than that, if they settle for blood-money, the value of the slain is upon the family of the killer or wounder.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

extra_refs.value: 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz (with Salim b. 'Abd Allah and a letter from 'Umar b. al-Khattab) (successor)

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: يُقَادُ الْعَبْدُ مِنَ الْعَبْدِ فِي الْقَتْلِ عَمْدًا، وَيُقَادُ الْعَبْدُ مِنَ الْعَبْدِ فِي الْجِرَاحِ عَمْدًا، فَإِنْ قُبِلَ الْعَقْلُ مِنَ الْعَبْدِ كَانَ عَقْلُ الْجِرَاحِ لِلْمَمْلُوكِ، كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا فِي ثَمَنِهِ بِقِيمَةِ عَدْلٍ، وَإِنْ قَتَلَ عَبْدٌ عَبْدًا عَمْدًا أُقِيدَ بِهِ فِي الْقَتْلِ، وَإِنْ أَرَادَ صَاحِبُهُ أَنْ يَسْتَحْيِيَ الْعَبْدَ أُعْطِيَ قِيمَةَ عَبْدِهِ الْمَقْتُولِ فِي ثَمَنِ الْعَبْدِ الْقَاتِلِ، لا يُزَادُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ إِلا إِنْ يُحِبَّ أَهْلُهُ أَنْ يُسَلِّمُوهُ بِجَرِيرَتِهِ، وَأَهْلُ الْعَبْدِ الْقَاتِلِ أَمْلَكُ بِأَنْ يُفْدُوهُ بِعَقْلِ الْعَبْدِ الْمَقْتُولِ أَوْ يُسَلِّمُوا الْعَبْدَ الْقَاتِلَ بِجَرِيرَتِهِ إِنْ شَاءُوا
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Yunus b. Yazid informed me, from Ibn Shihab, that he said:
records.matn_en: A slave is retaliated against for a slave in intentional killing, and a slave is retaliated against for a slave in intentional wounds. If the blood-money is accepted from the slave, the blood-money of wounds is [owed] to the slave, each of them in his price by a just valuation. If a slave kills a slave intentionally he is retaliated against in killing; and if his master wishes to spare the slave, he is given the value of his slain slave from the price of the killer slave, and no more is added to that, unless his owners wish to surrender him for his offense; and the owners of the killer slave have more right to ransom him with the blood-money of the slain slave or to surrender the killer slave for his offense, if they wish.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ:
records.matn_ar: الْقِصَاصُ بَيْنَ الْعَبِيدِ، قَالَ اللَّهُ تبارك وتعالى: {وَالْعَبْدُ بِالْعَبْدِ} [البقرة: 178] ، {وَالْجُرُوحَ قِصَاصٌ} [المائدة: 45] .
records.isnad_en: And Ibn Abi Salama said:
records.matn_en: Retaliation is [applicable] among slaves; God, Blessed and Exalted, said: {and the slave for the slave} [al-Baqara 2:178], {and for wounds is legal retribution} [al-Ma'ida 5:45].

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ: وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، فِي عَبْدٍ قَتَلَ عَبْدًا عَمْدًا:
records.matn_ar: يُسَلَّمُ الْقَاتِلُ إِلَى سَيِّدِ الْعَبْدِ الْمَقْتُولِ فَيَقْتُلَهُ، فَإِنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَسْتَحْيِيَهُ فَيَكُونَ عَبْدًا لَهُ، لَمْ يَكُنْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ إِلا عَنْ طِيبِ نَفْسٍ مِنْ سَيِّدِهِ
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb: And Ibn Abi al-Zinad said, from his father, regarding a slave who killed a slave intentionally:
records.matn_en: The killer is surrendered to the master of the slain slave, and he kills him; and if he wishes to spare him so that he becomes his slave, that is not his except with the goodwill of his master.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي حُرٍّ وَعَبْدٍ قَتَلا رَجُلا حُرًّا خَطَأً:
records.matn_ar: عَلَى الْحُرِّ نِصْفُ الدِّيَةِ وَتغلق رَقَبَةُ الْعَبْدِ، فَإِنْ كَانَ الْعَبْدُ خَيْرًا مِنْ نِصْفِ الدِّيَةِ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ إِلا نِصْفُ الدِّيَةِ
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab, that he said regarding a free man and a slave who killed a free man by mistake:
records.matn_en: Upon the free man is half the blood-money, and the slave's person is held [forfeit]; if the slave is worth more than half the blood-money, nothing is upon him except half the blood-money.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لِعَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ: حُرٌّ وَعَبْدٌ قَتَلا رَجُلا حُرًّا عَمْدًا قَالَ: الْحُرُّ يُقْتَلُ بِهِ، وَالْعَبْدُ لأَهْلِهِ. قَالَ: قُلْتُ: فَعَبْدٌ قَتَلَ حُرًّا عَمْدًا ، قَالَ: الْعَبْدُ لَهُمْ، قُلْتُ: فَأَرَادَ سَيِّدُ الْعَبْدِ أَنْ يُعْطِيَ الدِّيَةَ، وَيَقْضِيَ عَبْدَهُ، وَأَبَى أَهْلُ الْحُرِّ إِلا الْعَبْدَ، قَالَ: فَهُمْ أَحَقُّ بِهِ، هُوَ لَهُمْ. قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِعَطَاءٍ: إِنْ قَتَلَ حُرٌّ وَعَبْدٌ حُرًّا خَطَأً قَالَ: فِدْيَتُهُ مِنْ حِسَابِ ثَمَنِ الْعَبْدِ، فحصته دية الحر
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Muhammad b. 'Amr informed me, from Ibn Jurayj, who said:
records.matn_en: I said to 'Ata' b. Abi Rabah: “A free man and a slave killed a free man intentionally?” He said: “The free man is killed for it, and the slave belongs to his people.” I said: “And a slave who killed a free man intentionally?” He said: “The slave belongs to them.” I said: “And the slave's master wants to give the blood-money and settle for his slave, but the family of the free man insist on the slave?” He said: “They have more right to him; he is theirs.” I said to 'Ata': “If a free man and a slave kill a free man by mistake?” He said: “His ransom is by the reckoning of the slave's price; his share is a free man's blood-money.”

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: وَقَالَ عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ:
records.matn_ar: إِذَا جَرَحَ الْعَبْدُ الْحُرَّ خَطَأً أَوْ عَمْدًا، فَإِنَّ سَيِّدَ الْعَبْدِ بِالْخِيَارِ بَيْنَ أَنْ يُسَلِّمَ عَبْدَهُ أَوْ يُؤَدِّيَ عَقْلَ جِرَاحِ الْحُرِّ مَا كَانَتْ.
records.isnad_en: And 'Abd al-'Aziz b. Abi Salama said:
records.matn_en: If a slave wounds a free man, by mistake or intentionally, the slave's master has the choice between surrendering his slave or paying the blood-money for the free man's wounds, whatever they are.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الْجَبَّارِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ مَرْوَانَ بْنَ الْحَكَمِ قَضَى فِي الْعَبْدِ يَجْرَحُ الْحُرَّ أَنَّ الْعَبْدَ يُبَاعُ فَيُعْطَى الْمَجْرُوحُ ثَمَنَ جُرْحِهِ، وَلا يُسَلَّمُ إِلَيْهِ لِئَلا يُمَثِّلَ بِالْعَبْدِ أَوْ يُعَذِّبَهُ
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: 'Abd al-Jabbar b. 'Umar informed me, from Rabi'a b. Abi 'Abd al-Rahman,
records.matn_en: that Marwan b. al-Hakam ruled, regarding a slave who wounds a free man, that the slave is sold and the wounded person is given the price of his wound, and he is not surrendered to him, lest he mutilate or torture the slave.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: Marwan b. al-Hakam (reported by Rabi'a) (later authority)

records.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَسَمِعْتُ شِمْرَ بْنَ نُمَيْرٍ يُحَدِّثُ، عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ: إِذَا جَنَى الْعَبْدُ فَلَيْسَ عَلَى سَيِّدِهِ غُرْمٌ فَوْقَ رَقَبَتِهِ، إِنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يَفْتَدِيَهُ افْتَدَاهُ، وَإِنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُسَلِّمَهُ أَسْلَمَهُ
records.isnad_en: He said: And I heard Shimr b. Numayr narrate, from al-Husayn b. 'Abd Allah, from his father, from his grandfather, from 'Ali b. Abi Talib,
records.matn_en: that he said: If a slave commits an offense, nothing is due from his master beyond his person; if he wishes to ransom him he ransoms him, and if he wishes to surrender him he surrenders him.

narrators.en: Grandfather of al-Husayn b. 'Abd Allah (not named in the text)
Father of al-Husayn b. 'Abd Allah (not named in the text)
'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ: الْعَبْدُ لا يَغْرَمُ سَيِّدُهُ فَوْقَ نَفْسِهِ شَيْئًا، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ دِيَةُ الْمَجْرُوحِ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ رَقَبَةِ الْعَبْدِ فَلا زِيَادَةَ لَهُ
records.isnad_en: Ibn Wahb said: Yazid b. 'Iyad informed me, from 'Abd al-Malik b. 'Ubayd, from Mujahid, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Abbas, that he used to say:
records.matn_en: The master of the slave owes nothing beyond his person; even if the blood-money of the wounded is more than the slave's person, there is no addition for him.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ فِي الْعَبْدِ يَقْتُلُ الْحُرَّ عَمْدًا فَيَسْتَحْيِيهِ أَهْلُ الْمَقْتُولِ، أَيَكُونُ لِسَيِّدِهِ أَنْ يَأْخُذَهُ بِقِيمَتِهِ أَوْ بِالْعَقْلِ كَامِلا أَوْ يُبَاعُ عَلَيْهِمْ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: إِذَا اسْتَحْيَوْهِ خُيِّرَ سَيِّدُ الْعَبْدِ بَيْنَ أَنْ يُعْطِيَ الْقَوْمَ الدِّيَةَ كَامِلَةً وَبَيْنَ أَنْ يُسَلِّمَ غُلامَهُ إِلَيْهِمْ.
records.isnad_en: He said: And Malik said, regarding a slave who kills a free man intentionally and the family of the slain spare him: is his master entitled to take him at his value, or at the full blood-money, or is he sold on them? He said:
records.matn_en: If they spare him, the slave's master is given the choice between giving the people the full blood-money and surrendering his slave to them.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: قَالَ مَالِكٌ:
records.matn_ar: وَإِنْ جَرَحَ عَبْدٌ يَهُودِيًّا أَوْ نَصْرَانِيًّا عَقَلَ عَنْهُ سَيِّدُهُ مَا أَصَابَ، وَإِلا أَسْلَمَهُ يُبَاعُ، ثُمَّ يَدْفَعُ ثَمَنَهُ إِلَى الْيَهُودِيِّ أَوِ النَّصْرَانِيِّ، وَلا يُعْطِي الْيَهُودِيَّ وَلا النَّصْرَانِيَّ الْعَبْدَ الْمُسْلِمَ.
records.isnad_en: Malik said:
records.matn_en: If a slave wounds a Jew or Christian, his master pays the blood-money for what he inflicted, otherwise he surrenders him to be sold, then the price is given to the Jew or Christian; and the Muslim slave is not given to the Jew or Christian.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: قَالَ: وَسَمِعْتُ مَالِكًا يَقُولُ فِي جِنَايَةِ الْعَبْدِ:
records.matn_ar: إِنَّ مَا أَصَابَ مِنْ جُرْحٍ جَرَحَ بِهِ إِنْسَانًا، أَوْ شَيْءٍ اخْتَلَسَهُ مِنْ إِنْسَانٍ، أَوْ بَعِيرٍ احْتَرَسَهُ، أَوْ ثَمَرٍ مُعَلَّقٍ أَخَذَهُ، أَوْ سَرِقَةٍ سَرَقَهُ لا قَطْعَ فِيهَا، إِنَّ ذَلِكَ فِي رَقَبَةِ الْعَبْدِ إِنْ شَاءَ سَيِّدُهُ أَنْ يُعْطِيَ قِيمَةَ مَا أَخَذَ أَوْ أَفْسَدَ أَوْ جَرَحَ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ أَسْلَمَهُ فَسَيِّدُهُ فِي ذَلِكَ بِالْخِيَارِ، فَأَمَّا مَا دَفَعَ إِلَيْهِ بِعَمَلِهِ أَوْ أَدَانَ بِهِ، فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ يَكُونُ فِي ذِمَّتِهِ. قَالَ مَالِكٌ: وَذَلِكَ الأَمْرُ عِنْدَنَا.
records.isnad_en: He said: And I heard Malik say about the slave's offense:
records.matn_en: Whatever he inflicts of a wound with which he wounded a person, or something he snatched from a person, or a camel he stole, or hanging fruit he took, or a theft he committed for which there is no cutting: all that is on the slave's person; if his master wishes to give the value of what he took, spoiled or wounded he may, and if he wishes he surrenders him; his master has the choice in that. As for what was handed to him for his work or what he took on credit, that is in his own liability. Malik said: That is the practice with us.

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري

records.isnad_ar: وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ فِي الْعَبْدِ الَّذِي يُؤْذَنُ لَهُ فِي التِّجَارَةِ يَجْنِي الْجِنَايَةَ يُحِيطُ بِرَقَبَتِهِ وَعَلَيْهِ دُيُونُ النَّاسِ، فَيَجْتَمِعُ أَهْلُ الْجِنَايَةِ وَغُرَمَاءُ الْعَبْدِ، قَالَ:
records.isnad_en: And Malik said, regarding a slave who is permitted to trade and commits an offense that encompasses his person while the debts of people are upon him, so that the victims of the offense and the slave's creditors gather; he said:
records.matn_en: The slave is taken for his offense. [The text breaks off here: the source ends with a line of dots.]

narrators.en: 'Abd Allah b. Wahb b. Muslim al-Qurashi al-Misri
narrators.ar: عبد الله بن وهب بن مسلم القرشي المصري
